why: reskin_all.sh cannot run: ~/orca/Abyssal-Surge was rebuilt as a Unity project and no longer carries assets/motion or assets/mesh, so all 12 ids miss — including the original 8. That was reported as a hard blocker on new character meshes. It is not one.
keyFinding: Every shipped Assets/Art/Characters/<id>.fbx ALREADY carries the 22 Unity-canonical humanoid bones — the BONE_MAP rename ran on them when they were first produced. Measured across all 12 reskin reports: 22 bones each, zero required bones missing. So the skeleton was never lost; there are twelve donors sitting in the repo.
differsFromGlbScript: skeleton comes from --skeleton-fbx (a shipped FBX), not a motion-library GLB
BONE_MAP is SKIPPED — those bones are already canonical, and running the DEF-* filter over them would delete the whole skeleton
the canonical set is validated directly, same hard gate
mesh donor may be FBX or GLB (Higgsfield exports both)

proof.method: Zero-credit end-to-end proof: bind a shipped mesh through the exact path a generated mesh will take, then ask Unity the only question that matters — does CharacterImportPipeline.cs:163's avatar.isHuman gate pass.
proof.control: shipped guard.fbx — avatar isValid && isHuman, 22/22 bones mapped
proof.candidate: scout mesh onto scout's own skeleton via reskin_from_fbx
proof.result: isValid && isHuman, 22/22 bones mapped, 0 heat orphans, 8055 tris
proof.verdict: PASS — the FBX-skeleton path produces a Unity-humanoid FBX

twoDefectsFoundByTheProof.symptom: Unity built a VALID but NON-HUMAN avatar; Hips localPos (0, 0, 0.01) vs shipped (0, -0.02, 0.61)
twoDefectsFoundByTheProof.cause: export was missing apply_scale_options='FBX_SCALE_ALL'. The 0.01 is the FBX cm/m factor. Inside Blender the two skeletons were byte-identical — same object transform, same bone head_local, same root — so this was invisible until Unity was asked.
twoDefectsFoundByTheProof.fix: match every export parameter to reskin_character.py:428-438

twoDefectsFoundByTheProof.symptom: still non-human after the export fix: 20/22 bones, LeftHand and RightHand refused (both REQUIRED)
twoDefectsFoundByTheProof.cause: PROPORTION, not the pipeline. scout's mesh (1.6993) on guard's skeleton (1.1257) needs a 0.6625 height scale; the mesh shrinks while the donor skeleton stays full size and the auto-mapper stops believing the arm chain. Ratio 1.5095.
twoDefectsFoundByTheProof.notTheCause: Hand bones outside the mesh bounding box LOOKS like the cause and is not: shipped guard has hand tips at x=1.12 against a mesh span of 0.75 and maps 22/22. Measuring that first is what kept a wrong fix out.
twoDefectsFoundByTheProof.fix: MAX_HEIGHT_RATIO = 1.25 gate that fails loudly, with the remedy in the message (pick a closer donor, or generate at the donor's height — meshy_v6 exposes rigging_height_meters)
twoDefectsFoundByTheProof.gateProven: ratio 1.510 -> FATAL as designed; ratio 1.0 -> passes

procedure: 1. meshy_v6_text_to_3d with rigging_height_meters set to the donor skeleton's height (guard 1.1257, scout 1.6993 — read from the reskin report or the probe) and target_polycount <= 25000
4. the height gate rejects a mismatched generation before Unity sees it
5. CharacterImportPipeline.ImportAll picks it up from the directory glob
